title: SUPER B SPAIN & MOROCCO TRIP
text:
"We did a multi-day family tour through Andalusia and Morocco with Lina and Javi, and honestly it was the highlight of our whole trip — maybe one of the best travel experiences we've had as a family, full stop.
A bit of context: I'm one of those people with a foot in both worlds — American dad, Spanish mum, grew up between the two. I've been living in Seville for a few years now and when my family came over from Texas to finally see Andalusia properly, I felt this weird mix of local pride and tourist excitement all at once. author: K2707LCantoniom

title: Excellent arrangements
text: I reached out a few months ago, and received a helpful response from Luis. He described the trip, offered additional options, and responded to multiple questions. We made a nominal deposit to guarantee our reservation, paying the balance upon arrival. Luis drove us to the ferry, and we had a great opportunity to visit and learn things along the way about the region and culture of Spain. When we arrived in Morocco we were met by Karim who was our exception guide, arranged by Luis, for the day. author: AKTraveler_Les

title: Marruecos maravilloso
text: Luis organized an incredible trip for us, with impeccable attention from start to finish. The hotels, restaurants and tours he chose for us were exceptional, exceeding all our expectations. In addition, he was always very attentive and available to solve our doubts, responding quickly and efficiently. We especially appreciated the flexibility he had to make adjustments when our schedule changed. In short, he was a pleasure to work with, and I will certainly contact him again in the future to continue enjoying his wonderful services.
author: AnaGomRom

title: Magic in Morocco
text: Wonderful experience. They were attentive to us at all times, taking care of every detail. We will be back soon. Morocco was even more magical thanks to you.
author: V8064VKcarmenc
